06001.name: Alameda
06001.description: SAN BENITO COUNTYcourt systems are offline, causing work stoppages. California is reforming its criminal justice system by expanding its Clean Slate Law with Senate Bill No. 731 (SB 731), effective July 1, 2024. This bill mandates the Department of Justice to automatically consider relief for certain arrest records and convictions, with an estimated 225,000 Californians seeing convictions sealed and over a million eligible to petition a judge. The review process for these cases by the California Department of Justice may take several years. The Professional Background Screeners of America (PBSA) is lobbying for changes in California court reporting due to delays in providing accurate background checks. Most California county searches now require the subject's full name, including middle name if applicable. If no middle name, please indicate so on the order. All California counties have now removed Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from researcher access terminals, a process that began in 2020 with the expansion of the CA Privacy Act. This means researchers must directly request record information from County Clerks for potential criminal record matches, a protocol now implemented across all counties.
